$comment: The copy-lint's rule set (009 FR-017). Data, not code: tuning voice is a reviewable diff, not an edit to a checker. Every rule cites the constitution rule it derives from, or states that it derives from VOICE.md instead. Patterns are deliberately narrow — 009's assumption is precision over recall, because a check that cries wolf gets bypassed, and a bypassed check is worse than a narrow one.
languageScopeNote: English only (FR-025). These patterns are language-specific and would not transfer. Localised copy is out of scope and this check does not cover it — it must not be read as though it did.

rules.title: Copy must not motivate through guilt or shame
rules.rationale: Absence of practice must be met with an invitation, never a penalty. A person who lapsed is the person this product exists for.
rules.compliantExample: Whenever you're ready, there's a single breath waiting.
rules.violatingExample: You failed to practice yesterday. No more excuses.

rules.title: Copy must not apply urgency
rules.rationale: Urgency borrows motivation from anxiety. A practice that needs pressure to happen today will not still be happening in a year.
rules.compliantExample: There's no schedule to keep. Come back when it suits you.
rules.violatingExample: Last chance — practice now before it's too late.

rules.title: Copy must not present a countdown toward losing something
rules.rationale: A countdown makes the practice about defending a number. RULE-C6 says the same thing from the other side: a celebration must never become a threshold to defend.
rules.compliantExample: Twelve days of practice so far. It stays yours.
rules.violatingExample: 2 days left before you lose your progress.

rules.title: A streak must never be shown returning to zero
rules.rationale: RULE-C1 is structural: streaks pause, they never zero. Copy that says otherwise describes a product we did not build, and teaches the reader to fear a missed day.
rules.compliantExample: Your streak is paused. It picks up where it left off.
rules.violatingExample: You missed a day — your streak is back to zero.

rules.title: Rest must not be described as a lapse
rules.rationale: RULE-C4 makes rest a first-class, deliberately recordable state. Copy that reaches for lapse vocabulary to describe it collapses the distinction the data model was built to keep. Only the co-occurrence is mechanically detectable; the rest is VOICE.md's.
rules.compliantExample: Rest is practice. Mark today as rest.
rules.violatingExample: Rest day or missed day? Either way the streak lapses.

rules.title: Copy must not carry the vocabulary that marks generated text
rules.rationale: Not a constitution rule — this one is VOICE.md's own. These constructions are the register of a marketing page, and the product speaks as a teacher in a room. Each pattern is scoped to its giveaway phrase rather than the bare word, because 'unlock the hips' and 'elevate the ribs' are real cues a teacher gives.
rules.violatingExample: Embark on a journey to unlock your potential with our seamless practice experience.
